23/S0.subgoal: Explain the concept of technology 'disappearing' as a design goal for interactive systems and its historical context.

23/S1.subgoal: Explain why interactive systems should be designed for laypersons and the impact of technical jargon on user experience.

23/S2.subgoal: Describe the key characteristics and components of a user-centric design approach.

23/S3.subgoal: Define human-computer interaction (HCI) and explain its core concern.

23/S4.subgoal: Explain why it is important to characterize different user types using a practical example.

23/S5.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
